title: Screen Translator Internal Inventory
description: Internal inventory of the Screen Translator. Lists each visual unit detected in the legacy, with stable identity and traceability to the source code. Saved in _reversa_sdd/screens/inventory.json. Overwritten on each run.

sourcePlatform.description: Slug of the detected source platform (e.g., cobol-ansi-tui, delphi-vcl, asp-classic, android-xml, ios-xib).

screens.description: List of screens detected in the legacy.

id.description: Unique and stable identifier within this inventory (e.g., SCR-0001).

canonicalName.description: Canonical screen name used in target_screens.md.

file.description: Relative path of the legacy file.

line.description: Line in the file, when applicable.

paragraph.description: COBOL paragraph name, Delphi/VB6 form name, Android Activity, etc.

kind.description: Structural type of the screen. Use 'raw' when the adapter does not cover the type.

isCritical.description: Marks critical vs auxiliary screens (fed by reversa-detective when available). In hybrid mode, critical screens tend to go to literal.

matchesUiInventory.description: true if the screen appears in _reversa_sdd/ui/inventory.md.
